info.name: CarGurus Developer APIs Car Selector Dealer Stats API

params.name: body
params.description: JSON request body describing the dealer and date range.

items.docs: Retrieve inventory performance statistics for a dealer (Partner level or Dealer level). Requires an appId and authToken issued by CarGurus. Served from the v2.0 base URL. Response fields are modeled from CarGurus documentation and published examples.
